newsitem.title: UK: Br.Energy shutdowns to hit output gains.
newsitem.headline: Br.Energy shutdowns to hit output gains.

text.p: British nuclear generator British Energy Plc said on Friday that output increases of 4.6 percent in April and June from the year-earlier months would not continue for the rest of the year because of statutory shutdowns of power stations.

"This trend, will not, however, continue for the whole of this year as seven statutory shutdowns are currently planned this year, compared with four last year," chairman John Robb said at the company's first annual meeting since its flotation last summer.
Robb said that plans were "well in hand to reduce our costs per unit of electricity in order that we remain competitive".
"I am satisfied that British Energy is on course to make further progress this year," Robb said. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
